subject: Supply Chain & Logistics
title: Conflict Minerals
description: A tiny lesson with a big payoff: Conflict Minerals.

hook.text: Tin, tantalum, tungsten, and gold—the 3TG minerals. They power your electronics and fund armed conflict.

buildup.text: Conflict minerals are resources mined in war zones where profits finance violence and human rights abuses.

discovery.text: The Dodd-Frank Act requires US companies to disclose whether products contain conflict minerals from Congo.

twist.text: Tracing minerals through multiple smelters and middlemen is extremely difficult. Full certainty is rare.

climax.text: Industry certification programs now audit smelters to verify conflict-free sourcing across the supply chain.

punchline.text: Know your minerals. Know their cost—human and financial.

quiz.question: What does the Dodd-Frank Act require regarding minerals?
options: A ban on all mineral imports
Disclosure of conflict minerals from Congo in products
